name: Candy Fumez Deli
description:
Lineage: Zkittlez x Sherbanger

Breeder: Bloom Seed Co.

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool 

Effects: Sedative, Head & Body Buzz, Dream State 

Aroma: Floral, Berry, Funk, Earthy 

Get ready to take your taste buds on a joyride with Candy Fumez – the ultimate fusion of sweetness and fuel! Picture this: a candy store meets a gas station, and the result is a tantalizing blend of sugary delights with a hint of diesel. This strain is your ticket to a flavor-packed adventure where the gassy undertones rev up the fun. With Candy Fumez, you're not just enjoying a sweet treat – you're cruising through clouds of confectionery euphoria with a hint of fuel-injected excitement.
